verses.sloka: उपस्थितं तु तं दृष्ट्वा पुष्पकं पुष्पभूषितम् ।अविदूरस्थितो रामं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: upasthitaṁ tu taṁ dṛṣṭvā puṣpakaṁ puṣpabhūṣitam ।avidūrasthito rāmaṁ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.1 ।।

translations.english: Offering to Sri Rama the Pushpak decorated with flowers to sit, Vibheeshana stood at a distance and spoke.

verses.sloka: स तु बद्धाञ्जलिः प्रह्वो विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः ।अब्रवीत्त्वरयोपेतः किं करोमीति राघवम् ।। ६.१२५.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu baddhāñjaliḥ prahvo vinīto rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।abravīttvarayopetaḥ kiṁ karomīti rāghavam ।। 6.125.2 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king humbly offered salutation to Raghava with joined palms, quickly approached, and said, 'What is to be done'?
translations.hindi: सीता जी भी इस समय बड़ी भारी विपत्ति में पड़ी हैं और पीड़ित हैं । अतएव ऐसे समय, विशेष कर मेरी उपस्थित में इनका बिना परदे के आना, कोई भी दोष की वात नहीं है

verses.sloka: तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः ।विमृश्य राघवो वाक्यमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम् ।। ६.१२५.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamabravīnmahātejā lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvataḥ ।vimṛśya rāghavo vākyamidaṁ snehapuraskṛtam ।। 6.125.3 ।।

translations.english: Highly brilliant Raghava was thinking and spoke in a friendly manner while Lakshmana was listening closely.

verses.sloka: कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणो विभीषण वनौकसः ।रत्नैरर्थैश्च विविधैर्भूषणैश्चापि पूजय ।। ६.१२५.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtaprayatnakarmāṇo vibhīṣaṇa vanaukasaḥ ।ratnairarthaiśca vividhairbhūṣaṇaiścāpi pūjaya ।। 6.125.4 ।।

translations.english: "Let all the forest rangers (without exception) who made effort and fought be duly honoured with valuables and several luxuries."

verses.sloka: सहैभिरजिता लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर ।हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः ।। ६.१२५.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sahaibhirajitā laṅkā nirjitā rākṣaseśvara ।hṛṣṭaiḥ prāṇabhayaṁ tyaktvā saṅgrāmeṣvanivartibhiḥ ।। 6.125.5 ।।

translations.english: "This Lanka could be won with the help of these heroes who never turned back and fought in comb at without fear of life, O Lord of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: त इमे कृतकर्माणः पूज्यन्तां सर्ववानराः ।। ६.१२५.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ta ime kṛtakarmāṇaḥ pūjyantāṁ sarvavānarāḥ ।। 6.125.6 ।।

translations.english: "These forest rangers, all of them have struggled and accomplished success. Reward them with wealth and gems."

verses.sloka: धनरत्नप्रदानेन कर्मैषां सफलं कुरु ।। ६.१२५.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhanaratnapradānena karmaiṣāṁ saphalaṁ kuru ।। 6.125.7 ।।

translations.english: "These helpless monkey troops will be content with gratitude when rewarded, O respectable Vibheeshana."

verses.sloka: एव सम्मानिताश्चैते मानार्हा मानद त्वया ।भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निर्वृता हरियूथपाः ।। ६.१२५.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: eva sammānitāścaite mānārhā mānada tvayā ।bhaviṣyanti kṛtajñena nirvṛtā hariyūthapāḥ ।। 6.125.8 ।।

translations.english: "If you do so you will be called as charitable and kind, not seizing wealth and as one who has gained over senses. That is why I am telling you for so long."

verses.sloka: त्यागिनं सङ्ग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं यशस्विनम् ।सर्वे त्वामवगच्छन्ति ततः सम्बोधयाम्यहम् ।। ६.१२५.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tyāginaṁ saṅgrahītāraṁ sānukrośaṁ yaśasvinam ।sarve tvāmavagacchanti tataḥ sambodhayāmyaham ।। 6.125.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Ruler of men, all the army will desert a king who is devoid of virtues, lowly and who is a destructor in the battlefield."

verses.sloka: हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे ।त्यजन्ति नृपतिं सैन्याः संविग्नास्तं नरेश्वरम् ।। ६.१२५.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: hīnaṁ ratiguṇaiḥ sarvairabhihantāramāhave ।tyajanti nṛpatiṁ sainyāḥ saṁvignāstaṁ nareśvaram ।। 6.125.10 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana honoured the Vanaras with gems and valuables, after Rama had spoken like that.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वानरांस्तान् विभीषणः ।रत्नार्थैः संविभागेन सर्वानेवाभ्यपूजयत् ।। ६.१२५.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa vānarāṁstān vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।ratnārthaiḥ saṁvibhāgena sarvānevābhyapūjayat ।। 6.125.11 ।।

translations.english: Then on seeing the monkey troops being honoured with excellent gemsRama ascended the aerial car.

verses.sloka: ततस्तान् पूजितान् दृष्ट्वा रत्नैरर्थैश्च यूथपान् ।आरुरोह ततो रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।। ६.१२५.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastān pūjitān dṛṣṭvā ratnairarthaiśca yūthapān ।āruroha tato rāmastadvimānamanuttamam ।। 6.125.12 ।।

translations.english: ﻿ Illustrious Vaidehi was abashed while she was taken in his(Hanuman’s) arms to Pushpalata while the valiant archers Lakshmana and his brother were there .

verses.sloka: अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं लज्जमानां यशस्विनीम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता ।। ६.१२५.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅkenādāya vaidehīṁ lajjamānāṁ yaśasvinīm ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vikrāntena dhanuṣmatā ।। 6.125.13 ।।

translations.english: After duly honouring all the Vanaras, to Vibheeshana and highly courageous Sugriva, Kakuthsa spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च विमानस्थः पूजयन् सर्ववानरान् ।सुग्रीवं च महावीर्यं काकुत्स्थः सविभीषणम् ।। ६.१२५.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca vimānasthaḥ pūjayan sarvavānarān ।sugrīvaṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ kākutsthaḥ savibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.125.14 ।।

translations.english: "Bull among Vanaras! Since this work of the friend has been accomplished, you too have my permission to go where you will."

verses.sloka: मित्रकार्यं कृतमिदं भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमाः ।अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं प्रतिगच्छत ।। ६.१२५.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: mitrakāryaṁ kṛtamidaṁ bhavadbhirvānarottamāḥ ।anujñātā mayā sarve yatheṣṭaṁ pratigacchata ।। 6.125.15 ।।

translations.english: All that has to be done by an affectionate friend in advanced age has been done, for the fear of unrighteousness. Now you may advance with your army to Kishkinda.

verses.sloka: यत्तु कार्यं वयस्येन सुहृदा वा परन्तप ।कृतं सुग्रीव तत् सर्वं भवता ऽधर्म भीरुणा ।। ६.१२५.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yattu kāryaṁ vayasyena suhṛdā vā parantapa ।kṛtaṁ sugrīva tat sarvaṁ bhavatā 'dharma bhīruṇā ।। 6.125.16 ।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana, I would like to see you living like Indra bestowed with your own kingdom in Lanka. It will not be possible for even gods to attack you."

verses.sloka: विष्किन्धां प्रतियाह्याशु स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः ।। ६.१२५.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: viṣkindhāṁ pratiyāhyāśu svasainyenābhisaṁvṛtaḥ ।। 6.125.17 ।।

translations.english: "I shall proceed to my father's capital, Ayodhya. You may permit me. Be auspicious. I take leave of you."

verses.sloka: स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण ।न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्द्रा अपि दिवौकसः ।। ६.१२५.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: svarājye vasa laṅkāyāṁ mayā datte vibhīṣaṇa ।na tvāṁ dharṣayituṁ śaktāḥ sendrā api divaukasaḥ ।। 6.125.18 ।।

translations.english: After Rama had spoken that way Sugriva, Vibheeshana, monkeys and Rakshasas saluted Rama and said as follows.

verses.sloka: अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम ।अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वांश्चामन्त्रयामि वः ।। ६.१२५.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāṁ pratiyāsyāmi rājadhānīṁ piturmama ।abhyanujñātumicchāmi sarvāṁścāmantrayāmi vaḥ ।। 6.125.19 ।।

translations.english: We wish to proceed with you to Ayodhya, and many wishes to go with you and range the forests and groves without anxiety.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण वानरास्ते महाबलाः ।ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो रामं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstu rāmeṇa vānarāste mahābalāḥ ।ūcuḥ prāñjalayo rāmaṁ rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.20 ।।

translations.english: "O Jewel among kings! We will see you being consecrated and see Kausalya, greet her and return back to our own house."

verses.sloka: अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वान्नयतु नो भवान् ।उद्युक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनानि नगराणि च ।। ६.१२५.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāṁ gantumicchāmaḥ sarvānnayatu no bhavān ।udyuktā vicariṣyāmo vanāni nagarāṇi ca ।। 6.125.21 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Vanaras had spoken in that way, Rama replied to Sugriva, Vibheeshana and Vanaras as follows.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकार्द्रं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च ।अचिरेणागमिष्यामः स्वान् गृहान् नृपतेः सुत ।। ६.१२५.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tvāmabhiṣekārdraṁ kausalyāmabhivādya ca ।acireṇāgamiṣyāmaḥ svān gṛhān nṛpateḥ suta ।। 6.125.22 ।।

translations.english: "If I with my dear and near and together with you go to Ayodhya, that will give more happiness with Sita coming and with all of you."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः ।अब्रवीद्राघवः श्रीमान् ससुग्रीवविभीषणान् ।। ६.१२५.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ ।abravīdrāghavaḥ śrīmān sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇān ।। 6.125.23 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva and the Vanaras, quickly ascended the aerial car. Vibheeshana, the king of Rakshasas and ministers all of them ascended.

verses.sloka: प्रियात् प्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः ।सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः ।। ६.१२५.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: priyāt priyataraṁ labdhaṁ yadahaṁ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ।sarvairbhavadbhiḥ sahitaḥ prītiṁ lapsye purīṁ gataḥ ।। 6.125.24 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva with Vanaras happily joined the wonderful Pushpaka, Vibheeshana and his ministers also ascended.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं वानरै सह ।त्वमध्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण ।। ६.१२५.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṣipramāroha sugrīva vimānaṁ vānarai saha ।tvamadhyāroha sāmātyo rākṣasendra vibhīṣaṇa ।। 6.125.25 ।।

translations.english: All the Vanaras and others having got into Kubera's Pushpaka with Rama's permission, it flew into the sky.

verses.sloka: ततस्तत् पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह सेनया ।अध्यारोहत्त्वरन् शीघ्रं सामात्यश्च विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastat puṣpakaṁ divyaṁ sugrīvaḥ saha senayā ।adhyārohattvaran śīghraṁ sāmātyaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.26 ।।

translations.english: Delighted and thrilled, Rama was flying in the sky in Pushpaka and with shining swans, he shone like Kubera.

verses.sloka: तेष्वारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरं परमासनम् ।राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसम् ।। ६.१२५.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣvārūḍheṣu sarveṣu kauberaṁ paramāsanam ।rāghaveṇābhyanujñātamutpapāta vihāyasam ।। 6.125.27 ।।

translations.english: All those mighty monkeys and bears, and the rakshasas too, seated themselves at ease, without crowding, in that celestial car.

verses.sloka: ययौ तेन विमानेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता ।प्रहृष्टश्च प्रतीतश्च बभौ रामः कुबेरवत् ।। ६.१२५.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yayau tena vimānena haṁsayuktena bhāsvatā ।prahṛṣṭaśca pratītaśca babhau rāmaḥ kuberavat ।। 6.125.28 ।।

verses.sloka: ते सर्वे वानरा हृष्टा राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः ।यथासुखमसम्बाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन् ।। ६.१२५.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te sarve vānarā hṛṣṭā rākṣasāśca mahābalāḥ ।yathāsukhamasambādhaṁ divye tasminnupāviśan ।। 6.125.29 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe pañcaviṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 125 ।।
